title: Hearty Algerian Lemongrass Tagine
description: A salty and indulgent Algerian dish featuring lemongrass, this tagine is low in fat and perfect for a special occasion, it is cooked in a donabe vessel and finished on a yakimono grill.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium-high heat.
In a donabe vessel, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the donabe and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the donabe and cook for 1 minute.
Add the bruised lemongrass, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the donabe and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast to the donabe and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add 2 cups of water to the donabe and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the tagine for 20 minutes.
Finish the tagine on the yakimono grill for 5 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh lemongrass and parsley.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
